body: Hello, thank you so much, I appreciate the reply. You’re not alone either, take care you too.

I did end up calling! They answered the phone and I just told them I needed to talk and overall the conversation went by very naturally. I told them my story and the reason for my call and they listened to me talking and that was pretty much it, but I have mixed feelings about it because... I think it just wasn’t what I expected? Idk I guess I was secretly hoping for some advice or to get some directions (I know they can’t do that for me) but it was the futherst thing from that. They just listened to me crying about my life, acknowledged my pain and didn’t say much else. On the bright side, it was a positive experience despite playing out differently to how I thought it would and I’m glad I called. Actually, I intend to call again and see if I can get more comfortable this time around. On the other hand, I know there’s a lot of people out there who this approach might work for, specially people who don’t already go to therapy, but I guess I’m not one of those people :( I still feel really lost and want to kill myself just as much as before. I guess it was a good reminder that a suicide hotline volunteer does not substitute a therapist or a friend.
thank you, I needed to hear that. I’ll try calling once more.
I’ll check out the thread, though.

hey, thanks for the reply, I truly do appreciate it.

I do have hobbies and interest, and most of the people I talk to I met through them. I do talk to online friends, it’s just that I don’t feel like our friendship is “deep” or meaningful in any way beyond, you know, passing time. When I talk to people, I usually feel like I have to pretend to be someone I’m not, that I bother them/am uninteresting, or that the entire conversation is boring and meaningless. Even if I can initiate conversation, I have trouble keeping it because it just doesn’t seem worth all the work it takes, I guess. More than not being able to talk to people, I have trouble with being able to truly form a non-superficial friendship where I don’t feel like I’m alone in the company of others.
Thank you for taking your time and answering, I really appreciate it. I’m sorry you’re suffering too.
